sentences.text:
Rajkumar Kachhi vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March,
2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:12238
 1 
 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal

On The 11 th Of March, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 9591 of 2025
 Rajkumar Kachhi
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Jafar Khan - Advocate for the applicant.
 Smt. Shanti Tripathi - Panel Lawyer for the respondent/
 Order

This is the second application filed by applicant under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail in connection with Crime No. 289/2024 registered at Police Station Motinagar, District Sagar (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366-A, 376, 376(2)(n), 506, 344 of IPC and Section 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 24.03.2024.
First application was dismissed on merits.

2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he abducted the minor prosecutrix and committed rape with her therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against the applicant.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He is in custody since 24.03.2024.
It is submitted that age of the prosecutrix is about 18 years.
Prosecutrix in her statement recorded u/s 164 of Cr.P.C. has stated that she went with the applicant on her own will.
Court statement of prosecutrix and her father has been recorded which also reveals that prosecutrix is a consenting party.
Applicant has no NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:12238 2 MCRC-9591-2025 criminal antecedents.
Charge sheet has been filed and conclusion of the trial will take considerable time, therefore, it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail 4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent/State has opposed the bail application and prayed for it's rejection.

sentences.text: Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.

Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of B.N.S.S./439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant,
stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of B.N.S.S.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
